content.hook: A caterpillar packs 2,000 times its own weight in food - that is like you eating 80,000 cheeseburgers before kindergarten!
content.concept: Butterfly metamorphosis: egg to caterpillar to chrysalis to butterfly. The caterpillar eats 200x its body weight in milkweed, then its body melts into goo inside the chrysalis and rebuilds into a completely different creature in just 10 days.
content.activity: Be an observer like Temple Grandin! If you find a caterpillar, watch it daily and draw what you see. Scientists still do not fully understand how the goo knows to become wings.
content.challenge: Research: How many days total does a monarch butterfly live? (Hint: count the egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, and adult stages.)
content.parentNote: Metamorphosis is a classic 2nd grade science topic. This lesson builds observation skills and connects to the Temple Grandin story about careful watching. Encourage drawing and writing observations.
